subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule authority, or should conversational training stay in memory/plugin surfaces with narrower channel-specific mention fixes?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses durable storage, workspace-rule precedence, memory plugin ownership, conflict resolution, and channel reply semantics, so automation cannot choose the product boundary safely.

options.title: Design durable rule authority
options.body: Keep this issue open as the product design item and define the promotion, precedence, review, and migration boundaries before implementation.

options.title: Split channel bugs only
options.body: Treat durable rule learning as out of scope for now and track only the Feishu mention failures in the narrower open issues.

options.title: Plugin-only rule learning
options.body: Require durable conversational rule learning to live behind a memory/plugin API extension or ClawHub package unless core lacks a needed seam.

recommendation.title: Design durable rule authority
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the product design item and define the promotion, precedence, review, and migration boundaries before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The durable promotion part is closest to the memory dreaming and short-term promotion history Vignesh introduced, while Feishu-specific follow-through can route to the Feishu owners.
